page.overview:
Who is Nanni Galli?

Giovanni Giuseppe Gilberto "Nanni" Galli (2 October 1940 - 12 October 2019) was a Formula One driver from to . In 20 starts for , , . or , he scored no points, with his best finish a ninth place at the 1973 Brazilian Grand Prix. He did finish third in the non-championship 1972 Italian Republic Grand Prix in a Tecno. He also managed a moderate amount of success in sports cars of the era.
